title: Laxoox
description: Laxoox is a Djibouti classic prepared with all-purpose flour, sorghum flour, instant yeast. A measured home-style version, with ingredients assigned to the cooking steps where they are used.

steps.instruction: Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Cover the batter loosely and leave in a suitable warm, clean place for about 350 minutes to become bubbly and lightly tangy; do not refrigerate during active fermentation.
Cook the tangy laxoox batter in thin rounds, letting surface holes form before lifting; do not flip repeatedly.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
